description: Replaces EVERY occurrence of a literal string (no regex) across the whole document, or only in the tabs named by tab_ids. match_case defaults to true. Returns occurrencesChanged in the batchUpdate reply — 0 means the text was not found, not an error. Safer than replace_range for textual substitutions because it does not depend on indexes; use replace_range when position matters (e.g. only one of several occurrences).

document_id.description: The document id — the long id from the document URL (docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit) or from create_document output.

find.description: The literal text to find (no regex).

replace.description: The replacement text; empty string deletes the occurrences.

tab_ids.description: Limit the replacement to these tabs (from list_tabs); omit for all tabs.

name: replace_all_text
title: Find and replace text
